root_cause: ['auth', 'currentUser'] is written to the React Query cache via qc.setQueryData() but no useQuery hook ever subscribes to this key. TanStack Query v5 garbage-collects cache entries with no active observers after gcTime (default 5 minutes). RequireRole and RequireSuperAdmin read this entry synchronously via qc.getQueryData(); after the GC fires (~5 min after login), the read returns undefined, causing !user to be true and triggering a Navigate to='/login' redirect on any route re-render.
fix_description: Removed the dependency on ['auth', 'currentUser'] in both RequireRole and RequireSuperAdmin. Instead, the role is decoded directly from the access token (JWT) using a local jwtRole() helper that base64-decodes the payload section. The access token is kept alive by the useRefreshToken useQuery subscription and is never GC'd while the app is running.
